contentText: Fourteen countries from Europe, Africa and Oceania have acknowledged a landmark ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, calling on the country to comply with its obligations under international law. The United Kingdom separately announced sanctions against five senior Myanmar military figures and said it would formally recognise the genocide.
